1.1: A second wave of starting inside a year of starts: choose the one beginning that deserves your full attention and let the others wait their turn.
1.2: A fresh start sits a little oddly in a patient year, so begin gently. A small first step taken with another person tends to fit both.
1.3: A month of beginnings inside a playful year: start the piece, the page or the plan, and show it to one person before you polish it.
1.4: A burst of initiative inside a year of foundations: use it to lay the first stone of something steady, not to abandon the plan.
1.5: A push to begin inside a year of change: the new start may come easily, so decide what it is for before it carries you off.
1.6: A chance to start something for yourself inside a year of care: a small project of your own can sit alongside your responsibilities.
1.7: A month of beginnings inside a reflective year: act on one thing you have been thinking about and see what the first step teaches.
1.8: A fresh start inside a year of effort: begin the part of the goal that has been waiting for its moment, and set a pace you can keep.
1.9: A new beginning inside a year of endings: it may feel early, so keep it small and let the old chapter finish properly.

2.1: A patient month inside a year of starting: the details and the people behind the new thing may need attention before it can grow.
2.2: Quiet cooperation twice over: this can be a restful month, as long as your own preferences are said aloud and not left for others to guess.
2.3: A gentle month inside a lively year: listen as much as you talk, and let conversation be about the people, not only the performance.
2.4: Careful, cooperative work inside a year of building: the slower pace suits checking details and agreeing the plan with the people it affects.
2.5: A calm pocket inside a year of change: use it to hear what others think of the shifts, and to steady yourself before the next move.
2.6: A listening month inside a year of care: the people close to you may want your attention more than your help.
2.7: A soft, inward month inside a reflective year: rest, quiet company and small routines may do you more good than any plan.
2.8: A slower month inside a year of effort: agreements and relationships may move the work forward further than force would.
2.9: A tender month inside a year of endings: be gentle with yourself and the people involved, and let goodbyes take the time they need.

3.1: A sociable month inside a year of beginnings: talk about your new plan and notice which responses make you more eager and which make you doubt.
3.2: A lighter month inside a quiet year: let some playfulness in, and say the thing you have been holding back, with a little humor if it helps.
3.3: Expression twice over: make something, say something, enjoy something, and choose one of them to finish rather than all three.
3.4: A bright month inside a year of work: bring some fun to the routine, and let a creative idea improve a plan instead of derailing it.
3.5: A lively month inside a year of change: invitations and ideas may multiply, so choose the ones you can still say yes to in a week.
3.6: A warm month inside a year of care: gatherings, small celebrations and family stories may do more for the household than another task.
3.7: A talkative month inside a quiet year: share some of what you have been thinking, even before it is polished, and notice how it lands.
3.8: A creative month inside a year of effort: charm and good communication may help the work, so use them without letting them replace it.
3.9: A story-telling month inside a year of endings: tell the tale of what you have learned, in a form others can enjoy.

4.1: A steady month inside a year of starts: give the new thing some structure, such as a schedule, a list or a first budget of time.
4.2: A practical month inside a patient year: the details and paperwork may feel dull but can ease the months ahead.
4.3: A work-focused month inside a playful year: do the unglamorous part of the creative project, and let the rest be fun afterward.
4.4: Structure twice over: this can be productive and a little heavy, so build rest into the plan as deliberately as the tasks.
4.5: A grounding month inside a year of change: set up a routine or a home base that can carry you through the movement.
4.6: A practical month inside a year of care: fix the household systems and plan how responsibilities are shared.
4.7: A methodical month inside a reflective year: turn what you have been thinking into a plan, a schedule or a document.
4.8: A disciplined month inside a year of effort: steady, organized work may count for more now than grand gestures.
4.9: A tidy-up month inside a year of endings: sort records, finish the paperwork and file away what is complete.

5.1: A changeable month inside a year of beginnings: try a few approaches to the new thing and notice which one you want to keep.
5.2: A restless month inside a patient year: shake things up gently, and keep the people who depend on you informed about what is changing.
5.3: A busy month inside a lively year: variety and company are on offer, so pick a few experiences that actually feed you.
5.4: A shifting month inside a year of building: keep the plan, but be ready to adjust a step or two as the facts change.
5.5: Change twice over: this can feel exciting or dizzying, so keep one anchor, such as a daily routine, steady while everything else moves.
5.6: A mobile month inside a year of care: you may find that care travels well, and that others can handle some things at home.
5.7: A curious month inside a reflective year: get out and test your ideas against real places and people, then bring the lessons home.
5.8: A flexible month inside a year of effort: stay open to a change of tactics, and keep the goal clear while the route changes.
5.9: A moving month inside a year of endings: a trip, a clear-out or a change of scene may help close a chapter.

6.1: A caring month inside a year of beginnings: let the people close to you see the new thing and tell you what they notice.
6.2: A homely month inside a patient year: small, kind routines with the people you live with may be the best use of your time.
6.3: A generous month inside a lively year: host something, share a meal or tell the family story, and let joy count as care.
6.4: A responsible month inside a year of work: look after the practical needs of home and agree who is doing what.
6.5: A grounding month inside a year of change: return to the people who steady you and let them help you think through the moves.
6.6: Care twice over: this can be warm and heavy, so say what you need aloud and let others carry a share.
6.7: A quiet, caring month inside a reflective year: look after yourself as thoughtfully as you look after others.
6.8: A responsible month inside a year of effort: balance the demands of work with the people who matter, and schedule both.
6.9: A kind month inside a year of endings: forgive what you can, hand back what is not yours and look after those who are grieving a change.

7.1: A quiet month inside a year of starts: study the new thing before you commit fully, and let a little thinking improve the plan.
7.2: An inward month inside a patient year: rest, read and think, and let other people's views reach you without needing an answer.
7.3: A thoughtful month inside a lively year: save some of the talk for writing, and let reflection give your creative work more depth.
7.4: A reflective month inside a year of building: check the plan against what you actually want, and adjust before you add more.
7.5: A still month inside a year of change: pause, look over what has shifted and decide what you are keeping.
7.6: A quiet month inside a year of care: a little solitude may help you tell what the people around you need from what you assume they need.
7.7: Reflection twice over: a deep, quiet month that suits study, so share a thought now and then to keep a thread to other people.
7.8: A thinking month inside a year of effort: step back and ask what the work is for before you speed up again.
7.9: A reflective month inside a year of endings: look back over the cycle, write down what it taught and note what you want to carry forward.

8.1: A driven month inside a year of beginnings: put real effort behind the start, and set a goal that is ambitious and still possible.
8.2: A purposeful month inside a patient year: effort tends to work best through agreements and good relationships, not pressure.
8.3: A productive month inside a lively year: aim your creativity at a result, such as a finished piece, a pitch or a launch.
8.4: A heavy-duty month inside a year of building: effort and structure are aligned, so mind your hours and keep rest on the calendar.
8.5: A focused month inside a year of change: choose a goal and chase it through the shifts, adjusting the route but not the aim.
8.6: A demanding month inside a year of care: the pull between work and home may be sharp, so protect time for both.
8.7: An active month inside a reflective year: turn what you have been thinking into a decision, and be willing to be judged on it.
8.8: Effort twice over: this can be powerful and punishing, so set a firm stopping time each day and keep it.
8.9: A finishing month inside a year of endings: put your stamina into closing out the big commitments properly.

9.1: A finishing month inside a year of starts: close one small thing completely, and the next beginning may feel lighter.
9.2: A gentle clearing month inside a patient year: let go of a small grievance, and say a plain goodbye to something that has run its course.
9.3: A generous month inside a lively year: give something away, forgive something small and let humor soften an old tension.
9.4: A sorting month inside a year of building: archive what is complete and discard what is no longer part of the plan.
9.5: A clearing month inside a year of change: shed what no longer fits, so the next move has room.
9.6: A releasing month inside a year of care: hand back what is not yours to carry, and let others manage their own business.
9.7: A summing-up month inside a reflective year: write down what the past weeks and months have shown you, and what you can set down.
9.8: A wrapping-up month inside a year of effort: close accounts of time and energy, and give yourself credit for what was done.
9.9: Completion twice over: a good month for endings and generosity, with fewer new plans and more room for rest.
